title: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds: Travel Grants
summary: Travel grants for doctoral, MD and post-doctoral students pursuing experimental projects in basic biomedical research to attend practical training courses or short-term research stays worldwide or in Europe.

degree_levels.notes: Aimed at doctoral, MD, and post-doctoral students, as well as graduates who have applied for an experimental PhD project (requires at least a BSc). Post-doc track is excluded from student scope.

institutions.notes: No specific institution restrictions mentioned, applies to institutes worldwide or in Europe.

nationality.notes: Open to all Europeans and to non-Europeans working in Europe, and non-Europeans outside Europe for stays in Europe.

residence.notes: Open to Europeans and non-Europeans working in Europe to go to institutes worldwide, and non-Europeans working outside Europe to apply for stays in Europe.

mandatory.text: Pursuing experimental projects in basic biomedical research
Doctoral students must not have obtained their first university entrance qualification more than 11 years before the planned start of the travel grant (postdoctoral candidates no more than 13 years)

funding.description: Allowance which may cover the expenses for travel to and from the respective destination, lodging, and course fees.

application_rounds.notes: Applications are welcome at any time, but must be submitted at the latest 6 weeks before, but not earlier than 6 months prior to the planned date of departure.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications are welcome at any time, but must be submitted at the latest 6 weeks before, but not earlier than 6 months prior to the planned date of departure.

steps.text: Application forms and further information on the application procedure are available via the external application link.

sources.title: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds: Travel Grants - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme funds international doctoral, MD, and post-doctoral students to undertake short-term research stays or practical training courses in Germany (and worldwide/Europe), fulfilling physical research/study in Germany for students.
